summary: BEAM ~$0.00496, flat over 24h (-0.5%) after a ~50% jump on 29-30 Oct. The one real event: Beam/Merit Circle burned the BEAM sitting in the Binance hacker's wallet (~984M tokens, reported ~$3.3M) on 30 Oct, removing an overhang rather than adding demand. Most of the buzz is scanner 'top gainer' posts chasing the move, which doesn't count as bullish news. Already-run-up coin with a buzz spike, so treat with caution.
